purpose: Determine whether proxy supervision and GRPO justify further investment

proxy.method: R0 visual mean cosine including self-video in train bank

grpo.std_deviation_from_reference: Actual Swift sample std differs from standalone population-std mathematical helper; not silently patched
grpo.kl_implementation: Actual Swift4.6 K3 safety clamps, not unclamped standalone helper

formal_zero_signal_policy.requirements: All 256 optimizer calls, 1024 prompt exposures and 4096 generated/consumed completions are verified from raw ledgers; every reward group has zero variance, actual advantages/gradient norms/current-old-ref differences/KL and independently reconstructed losses are zero; initial/final adapter identities are identical; real pre-step optimizer learning rates include positive values. Reject variance-positive zero-gradient runs or optimizer failures.

evaluation.invalid_window: all zero scores included in overlap average denominator

merge_numeric_acceptance.definition: The common S0 is the actual BF16 merged checkpoint after every merged tensor is verified against BF16(float32(base)+2*(B@A)) and every non-LoRA tensor is bitwise unchanged. This does not assert pre-merge functional equivalence; preserve the original failed log-probability comparison and measured gap. All continuation arms and S0 evaluation share this exact merged endpoint.

initial_failure.scope: Historical evidence supporting the pre-freeze common-endpoint definition; these weights do not validate a later technical SFT endpoint.

merge_numeric_acceptance.reference_after_adapter_update: exact same fixed-answer token logps relative to the actual verified merged S0

technical_budget.input_pool: The same first eight unique real R0 training windows; restart technical SFT from the original Qwen base.
technical_budget.reason: The completed GRPO v5 technical loop generated and consumed 16 invalid answers: every reward was -1, group reward std and advantages were zero, and the observed LoRA gradients and parameter changes were zero. Increase only technical SFT format warm-up to 32 updates to verify a nonzero training signal; retain the zero-signal run as valid negative evidence. Use two concurrency updates because the first cosine warm-up step has learning rate zero.

technical_gate: Real preprocessing and full input audit; separately registered technical SFT warm-up, GRPO four-update save/reload and at least two formal-concurrency probe updates; verify the current actual merged S0 tensors and invariant reference before freeze. Formal matrix budgets remain unchanged.
